t: Goodies Speed Shop [Archive] - Pro-Touring.com
s: Speed Merchant held its own until 2007. It did pretty well for itself considering some serious lack in support from business owners and absence of advertising over the years, as well as the closure of drag strips that helped support the revenue at the shop such as Salinas and Vacaville as well as the track most recognizeable to gear heads...Fremont Dragstrip (later known as Baylands Raceway). As of March 2007 Goodies Speed Shop is now in business in the original location and its destined to be a more powerful force than it ever was.
